servinfo.title: Inspection of ECM and Its Circuits

item.ptxt: As each terminal voltage is affected by battery voltage, check that battery voltage is 12 V or more when ignition is “ON”.
Voltage with asterisk (*) cannot be measured with voltmeter because it is pulse signal. Use oscilloscope for its check.
Before performing this inspection, read “Precautions for ECM Circuit Inspection” under Precautions for Engine (K12D) .
